name: Skateboard for Brainrots
desc:
Welcome to Skateboard for Brainrots! 🛹

1. Use your Skateboard to reach OP Brainrots!
2. Make sure not to fall into the void!🤾‍♂️
3. Bring brainrots back to your Base to earn Cash! 💵
4. Upgrade your speed and jump to get further!

Don’t forget to hit the thumbs up! 👍
